first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the completion decline and has evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption. Promotional pricing responds to competitor pressure but carries a known 30-day retention risk that conflicts with sustainable qualified revenue. Verification should confirm the downstream outcomes and tradeoff before committing.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding-simplification experiment only for simple-workspace SMB accounts, explicitly excluding complex workspaces. This directly addresses the 4% completion decline and should improve time-to-value without exposing the known high-risk segment to removed setup steps. Do not pursue promotional pricing: despite acquisition and qualified-revenue lift, its 12% retention decline conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Measure activation, completion, time-to-value, and downstream retention before any expansion.
